title: Parity Claim
description: The honest, evidence-gated parity claim a run is allowed to make. Emitted into receipts/manifest.json and mirrored as the DEFENSIBILITY.md headline. A run may NEVER assert a tier above what reconciliation-against-captured-legacy-samples earned. See references/defensibility-and-claims.md and SKILL.md rule #9.

tier.description: unverified = recon did not run OR zero legacy samples OR zero paired comparisons (NO parity may be claimed). partial = ran against legacy, coverage/contract gaps remain (bounded claim). verified = ran against legacy, all targets met or tombstone-waived (equivalence within drift tolerance, bounded by coverage). failed = recon ran and a strict field drifted beyond tolerance or a hard stop tripped -> block release (rule #6).

parity_statement.description: Human-readable claim, scoped to the tier. At 'unverified' it MUST NOT assert parity (e.g. 'Target behavior recorded; NOT verified against legacy.').

drift_tolerance_ref.description: Pointer to the drift rules under which equivalence is claimed (config drift block / scoring profile).

ran.description: Did the reconciliation harness actually execute? false -> tier is unverified.

legacy_sample_count.description: Captured LEGACY behavior samples. 0 -> unverified (recording only the target proves nothing).

paired_comparison_count.description: legacy<->target comparisons actually performed (needs both sides for the same stimulus). 0 -> unverified.

strict_drift_within_tolerance.description: Were all strict fields within drift tolerance? false -> tier is failed (rule #6).

contracts_covered.description: Contracts with >= min_samples_per_contract AND >= 1 paired comparison.

gaps.description: Named items dragging the tier below 'verified'. A gap with no waived_by_tombstone forces 'partial'; a waived gap stays in the list (recorded as accepted, never laundered out).

what.description: e.g. 'security_flows coverage 0.01 < 0.05' or 'cid-packs-delete-003 has 0 paired comparisons'.

waived_by_tombstone.description: TOMBSTONES.md anchor if this gap was explicitly accepted; absent = unwaived (forces 'partial').
